entry.hops: The PC host and the daemon channel are joined, as in the Node test, by a JSON hop standing for the desktop session connection (JSON over HTTP). Every message that crosses it is recorded as the text that crossed, in order, under each case's `wire` (host->daemon operation + args text, daemon->host reply text, daemon->host request-event text); the host and the channel receive what JSON.parse of that text gives, so nothing passes that JSON changed unrecorded.
entry.notRun: no provider request: a live PC provider is an instance of the class Node's registry builds for its name (realInstance: what it advertises is the class's own) with a scripted `send`; the registry module, and the providers of the cases that script a whole provider, are scripted objects; setTimeout / setInterval (the heartbeat of the host) run on a virtual clock per case (armed, fired and pending timers are recorded under timers), with the injected `now` for the lease; deadlines use the real clock
entry.runs: apps/desktop/src/main/model-proxy-host.ts (createModelProxyHost, createModelProxyRuntime, modelProxyCredentialProbe) over the real ModelProxyChannel, ModelProxyProvider and loadModelProxyProviderConfig of the daemon side, joined through a JSON hop as the session connection does; resolveWireRoute / pinSessionWireRoute; the real provider-api-key helpers

scripted.source: crypto.randomUUID answers 00000000-0000-4000-8000-<counter, 12 digits> from 1, in call order

standIns.AbortSignal: an AbortSignal is stored as { aborted, reason } (reason through exact); a function inside provider options is stored as { function: <name> }

normalised.reason: per-run temp path (or generated name) replaced by a placeholder

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.compare: each case's observed fields through the product's entry, compared whole through fieldMap; the envelope of the replaced protocol is declared under replaced
replay.entry: mixdog-core/src/run_host/model_proxy_host_run_replay_tests.rs drives `modelProxy/run` / `modelProxy/cancel` on ModelProxyService (mixdog-core-domains/src/domains/ai_admin/model_proxy_service.rs, registered by compose_flip.rs) over ProxyRunner, with this PC's PcQuotaProbe, PcWireRouter and PcProviderConfig; mixdog-core/src/run_host/model_proxy_host_config_replay_tests.rs replays the providerConfig cases through PcProviderConfig over the product registry and DefaultProviderBuilder; mixdog-core/src/run_host/model_proxy_host_server_replay_tests.rs replays the server's read (Node loadModelProxyProviderConfig) through HostProxyProviders (mixdog-core/src/run_host/proxy_providers.rs).

replaced.protocol: Node's claim/event/resolve host (modelProxyClaim/Event/Resolve, its heartbeat, lease and snapshot event) is replaced by the typed modelProxy/run request and its modelProxy/run/event notifications: mixdog-app-protocol/src/inventory.rs:848-858 marks the operations Deleted
replaced.reason: the envelope, timers and lease bookkeeping of the replaced protocol; the protections they carried are replayed on the typed path: a run ends with its connection's cancel token (case 7), the frame bound refuses an oversized call before any provider runs (case 19), a provider-config read is bounded by its one-second budget (cases 21/22)

failure (one helper: node_failure / type.name: AbortError -> failure.delivery ambiguous and kind transient (cancelled); any other name -> not cancelled
failure (one helper: node_failure / type.props.partialContent: the run's textDelta events before the failure
failure (one helper: node_failure / type.props.name: equal to name

callbacks (one helper: typed_of_callback.[reset, chars]: ProxyEvent::AttemptDiscarded; chars equals the text of the discarded attempt

result.content: the textDelta events after the last AttemptDiscarded
result.settledCalls / hostRunning* / running*: the run's answer (sent or failed) and the run leaving ModelProxyService.runs (close returns)

provider calls.messages / model / tools / options.sessi: the ModelRequest the provider's attempt receives
provider calls.options.toolExecutionSessionId: '': no typed field: no tool executes on the PC

declared.2 result.content: "Hello again" is the stand-in's literal return (model-proxy-host.test.mjs:172), not what its callbacks streamed after the reset; a typed provider's content is its stream, compared as the text after the discard
declared.4 forget: forgetCredentials is no ProxyCall variant (mixdog-app-protocol/src/v2/model_proxy.rs ProxyCall): refused as invalid params before anything runs
declared.5 cachedFlash.firstResponseBudget: a budget that is not a number has no typed form (ProxyBudget is two u64)
declared.13 options: baseURL, requestHeaders, extraBody, codexInstallationId, _providerSeam are not ProxyOptions fields and are dropped as the call is read
declared.19 maxRequestBytes: Node's 200-byte cap was the test host's option; the typed bound is Limits::max_inbound_frame_bytes, checked by decode_inbound_text
declared.21/22 waitMs: a read's budget is one second for every read (proxy_providers.rs WAIT), not chosen per caller
declared.23 long + short wait: no per-read budget exists, so two unforced reads join one request (1, not Node's 2 more)
declared.24/28 mixdog-local: the Rust registry never builds mixdog-local (mixdog-ai registry/builder.rs:1286: built per turn from the managed runtime's endpoint); its rows are removed from case 24's input and answer, and case 28's localTraits is left unreplayed
declared.24 developer options: recorded twice (golden cases 24 and 24b): the recorder gates the registry init and the credential probe on the stored Developer options through Node's own developerOptionEnabled / developerOptionForProvider (src/runtime/shared/developer-options.mjs), once with none stored (mimo-oauth, cursor-oauth, antigravity-oauth never admitted, authState absent) and once with the three on; both states are built from the core (the world's config carries the same developer section; the three sign-in files the real adapters need are the ones a login leaves) and compared whole
declared.24 custom anthropic inputExcludesCache: fixed in the core, compared whole: a custom provider on the anthropic protocol is an AnthropicProvider subclass in Node (custom-provider.mjs:162, registry.mjs:554 providerInputExcludesCache and model-proxy-host.ts:1202 read the instance's class); ProviderAdapter::input_excludes_cache (mixdog-core-api domain/provider.rs) is stated by HttpAdapter for that engine (registry/builder.rs build_custom_parts) and read first by the accounting (registry/accounted.rs) and the advertisement (model_proxy_pc.rs traits_of)
declared.12 result.content / keyReads / anthropic: replayed on the real registry (model_proxy_host_config_replay_tests.rs only_the_requested_providers_key_is_read_when_the_request_is_made): a send to openai through the adapter PcProviderConfig serves, with a vault that logs its reads and a transport that keeps the request headers; result.content is the key Node's scripted send returned (openai:<key>), compared with the bearer the adapter sent; keyReads with the vault's reads; anthropicKeyInLastInit with the absence of any anthropic read
declared.14 transport scope: typed field ProxyOptions.forkedTransportScope (mixdog-app-protocol v2/model_proxy.rs), set by request_out when the sender names a transport scope (model_proxy.rs options_out); the PC allocates <session>#proxy:<uuid> and releases it through ProviderAdapter::release_transport_scope when the run ends (ProxyRunner::run, ProxyCall::Send); the recording's uuids are a scripted counter, so a scope is compared with its uuid replaced by <uuid> and its form asserted; closed (the global close hook) and released (the provider's releaseTransportScope) are one release; replayed by a_forked_side_request_gets_its_own_transport_scope_released_when_it_ends
declared.28 localTraits: WAITING on the registration of mixdog-local in the Rust registry: DefaultProviderBuilder::build answers "mixdog-local is built per turn from the managed runtime's endpoint" (mixdog-ai registry/builder.rs:1286), so a registry-built provider with takesImages=false does not exist yet. The branch that adds MixdogLocalProvider's registration (the local-runtime provider in mixdog-services local_provider, composed by mixdog-app-server-daemon compose_domains/local.rs) owns it; this repository has no such branch to name. Until then only the openai half of case 28 and the mixdog-local row of cases 24/24b are not replayed
declared.24b firstResponseBudget (mimo-oauth, ant: Node's classes state a budget (mimo-oauth.mjs:157 compatFirstResponseBudget, antigravity-oauth.mjs:110 antigravityFirstResponseBudget; recorded as transportMs 2715000 / semanticMs 5280000 and 427000 / 847000); no adapter of the core implements ProviderAdapter::first_response_budget (mixdog-core-api domain/provider.rs), so the core advertises none. The test asserts Node's figures and compares everything else of the answer whole; the gap also leaves the agent watchdog's first-response floor (factory.rs:1086) at its default for these two
declared.14 cancelled.rejected: Node's rejection of a cancelled side request is the abort reason of the server's own signal ("user stop"), not this PC's; the PC's part, the run ending as a cancellation with its scope released, is compared
